name: House meeting: bills and chores
title: House meeting
setting: monthly house meeting of three roommates
facts: Rent is $2,400 a month, split equally ($800 each), due on the 1st to the landlord, Mrs. Okafor.
Jordan pays the internet bill, $75 a month; Alex and Mei each owe Jordan $25.
Mei paid the September electricity bill, $186; Alex and Jordan each owe Mei $62.
Lease section 7: no pets without the landlord's written approval.
Lease section 9: a guest staying more than 7 nights in a row needs the landlord's notice in advance.
Trash goes out Monday and Thursday nights; recycling every other Monday, next on October 26.
Quiet hours are 11 pm to 7 am on weeknights.
This week's chores: Alex the kitchen, Jordan the bathroom, Mei the floors.

name: Hackathon demo planning
title: Team sync: demo video
facts: The demo video must be 2 to 3 minutes and show the project running.
Submissions close Saturday at 3 pm Eastern; late submissions are not accepted.
Judging: use of Higgs 30%, user experience 25%, innovation 25%, technical execution 20%.
Priya records the voice-over, Sam edits the video, Alex runs the live demo.
The repo must be public and its README must have setup steps.

name: Launch go/no-go (AI named Nova)
title: Launch go/no-go
facts: Launch: Thursday, November 5 at 10 am Pacific.
Go criteria: crash-free sessions at least 99.5%, p95 API latency under 300 ms, zero open P0 bugs.
Current numbers: crash-free sessions 99.62%, p95 API latency 340 ms, one open P0.
The open P0 is PAY-512: refunds in euros are charged twice. Owner: Jordan. The fix is in review.
Rollout: 5% of users on day 1, 25% on day 2, 100% on day 3.
A rollback takes about 12 minutes.
On-call in launch week: Sam primary, Jordan secondary.
The press embargo lifts at launch time.

name: Standup (AI named Max)
title: Daily standup
facts: Release 4.2 code freeze is Wednesday at 5 pm.
PAY-418 (webhook retries) is 8 points and owned by Dev.
PAY-430 (CSV export timeout) is 3 points and unassigned.
Staging is down for maintenance until 2 pm today.
The sprint ends Friday; 34 of 52 points are done.
Dev is out sick today.

name: Trip planning (one-to-one)
title: Lisbon trip
facts: Flight TP 202 to Lisbon leaves Friday, June 12 at 7:40 am from JFK terminal 1 and lands at 7:55 pm Lisbon time.
In June, New York is 5 hours behind Lisbon.
The hotel is Casa Azul: 4 nights, check-in from 3 pm, €145 a night.
Grandma's wheelchair assistance is booked at both airports.
The budget for the whole trip is $3,000; the flights already cost $1,480.
Sunday is a day trip to Sintra: the train from Rossio station takes 40 minutes and costs €2.40 each way.
The return flight is Tuesday, June 16 at 11:30 am.

name: Study group: biology exam
title: Bio exam study group
setting: study group for a biology exam
facts: The exam is Thursday at 9 am in room B204 and lasts 90 minutes.
It covers chapters 4 to 7: cellular respiration, photosynthesis, cell division and genetics.
Format: 60 multiple-choice questions and 3 short answers; it is worth 30% of the final grade.
Calculators are not allowed.
Professor Lin's office hours are Wednesday 2 to 4 pm.
Mei has the chapter 6 notes; Alex has last year's practice exam.

name: Mock interview (one-to-one)
title: Mock interview
setting: mock job interview practice: the AI plays the interviewer for a junior backend engineer role
facts: The role: junior backend engineer at Lumen Health (Python, Postgres, AWS).
The real interview is Monday at 11 am: 45 minutes on video.
Its structure: 10 minutes of intro, 25 minutes technical, 10 minutes for the candidate's questions.
Alex's main project: a Flask API for the student food bank that served about 400 students a week.
Alex wants feedback on rambling and on filler words.
